f.title: Secure investigator compliance or stop shipments and end the investigator's participation
f.statement: A sponsor who discovers that an investigator is not complying with the signed agreement, the investigational plan, part 812 or other applicable FDA regulations, or any conditions of approval imposed by the reviewing IRB or FDA shall promptly either secure compliance, or discontinue shipments of the device to the investigator and terminate the investigator's participation in the investigation.

rows.quote:
(a) Securing compliance. A sponsor
who discovers that an investigator is
not complying with the signed agreement, the investigational plan, the requirements of this part or other applicable FDA regulations, or any conditions of approval imposed by the reviewing IRB or FDA shall promptly either secure compliance, or discontinue
shipments of the device to the investigator and terminate the investigator’s
participation in the investigation.

f.title: Require a non-compliant investigator to dispose of or return the device
f.statement: A sponsor shall also require such a non-compliant investigator to dispose of or return the device, unless this action would jeopardize the rights, safety or welfare of a subject.
f.exceptions: Unless disposal or return would jeopardize the rights, safety or welfare of a subject

rows.quote:
A
sponsor shall also require such an investigator to dispose of or return the

f.title: Immediately evaluate any unanticipated adverse device effect
f.statement: A sponsor shall immediately conduct an evaluation of any unanticipated adverse device effect.

rows.quote: (1) A sponsor shall immediately conduct an evaluation of any unanticipated adverse device effect.

f.title: Terminate investigations presenting an unreasonable risk from a UADE as soon as possible
f.statement: A sponsor who determines that an unanticipated adverse device effect presents an unreasonable risk to subjects shall terminate all investigations or parts of investigations presenting that risk as soon as possible.

rows.quote:
(2) A sponsor who determines that an
unanticipated adverse device effect
presents an unreasonable risk to subjects shall terminate all investigations
or parts of investigations presenting
that risk as soon as possible.

f.title: Terminate within 5 working days of determining the UADE presents an unreasonable risk
f.statement: Termination shall occur not later than 5 working days after the sponsor determines that the unanticipated adverse device effect presents an unreasonable risk to subjects.

rows.deadline: Not later than 5 working days after the unreasonable-risk determination
rows.quote:
Termination shall occur not later than 5
working days after the sponsor makes
this determination

f.title: Terminate within 15 working days of first receiving notice of the UADE
f.statement: Termination shall also occur not later than 15 working days after the sponsor first received notice of the unanticipated adverse device effect.

rows.deadline: Not later than 15 working days after the sponsor first received notice of the effect

f.title: Do not resume a terminated significant risk device investigation without IRB and FDA approval
f.statement: If the device is a significant risk device, a sponsor may not resume a terminated investigation without IRB and FDA approval.

rows.quote:
(c) Resumption of terminated studies. If
the device is a significant risk device,
a sponsor may not resume a terminated investigation without IRB and
FDA approval.

f.title: Do not resume a terminated non-significant risk investigation without IRB approval
f.statement: If the device is not a significant risk device, a sponsor may not resume a terminated investigation without IRB approval.

rows.quote:
If the device is not a
significant risk device, a sponsor may
not resume a terminated investigation
without IRB approval and, if the investigation was terminated under paragraph (b)(2) of this section, FDA approval.
rows.review_note: Review: split; the FDA-approval condition after a (b)(2) UADE termination moved to a separate core_pv_clinical row (SME refinement of the earlier 812.46(c) ruling).

f.title: Do not resume a non-significant risk investigation terminated for a UADE without FDA approval
f.statement: If the device is not a significant risk device and the investigation was terminated under 812.46(b)(2) because an unanticipated adverse device effect presented an unreasonable risk to subjects, the sponsor may not resume it without FDA approval (in addition to IRB approval).

rows.quote: if the investigation was terminated under paragraph (b)(2) of this section, FDA approval.
